subject: Decision map request — who signs for AI infra pilot?
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Dunn <avery.dunn@velotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Decision map request — who signs for AI infra pilot?

Hi Avery — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and three asks so we can move the pilot forward.

Recap from call:
- Use case: 8-week inference pilot to validate 50k daily inference calls for recommendation service (90% P95 latency target).
- Success criteria: <=120ms P95 for 512-token requests, cost target <$0.0015 per 1k tokens, security checklist signed.
- Timeline: internal pilot start target mid-August; procurement/legal loop expected in parallel.

Asks (can you help confirm):
1) Economic buyer / final approver: who signs the PO or T&Cs?
2) Security & legal contacts: who will need SOC2 / security questionnaire and who owns data retention decisions?
3) Procurement flow: do we go through a single procurement inbox or a ProcNet system (and any PO templates)?

If helpful, I attached a very short SOW template and a one-page checklist we use to speed procurement reviews. Can you also drop a quick org chart or names/emails for the folks above? Even a 1‑page PNG/PDF is perfect.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync next week with the econ buyer + security lead so we can walk the checklist and share SOC2. Suggested windows: Tue 8/1 9–11am PT or Thu 8/3 10–11am PT.

Thanks — copying Ben (CS lead) and Marissa (solutions) to help prep the checklist and SOC2 artifacts.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template_v1.docx

On Tue, Jul 30, 2028 at 9:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Avery — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and three asks so we can move the pilot forward.

Thanks Naomi — great summary. Quick responses inline below and attaching our org snapshot.

1) Econ buyer: Marcus Lee (VP of Platform) is the final approver for platform/tool purchases >$50k. He handles budget sign-off and vendor selection. (Marcus is cc'd here.)
2) Security/legal: our security lead is Suhas Patil (SRE/InfoSec); legal review is handled by external counsel but the Legal Ops intake goes to legal@velotech.com. Data retention is owned by Product (Amy Chen), but Suhas signs the tech security checklist.
3) Procurement: we use procurement@velotech.com for initial docs; large orders go through our Ariba instance and require a standard PO. Procurement will ask for SOC2 Type II report, data flow diagram, and standard contractual terms redline.

Attached: Velotech_org_chart.pdf (very small, internal) — will follow up with Amy's direct.

We can do Thu 8/3 10am PT for the 30m sync. Marcus and Suhas are available then. Can you send a calendar invite with a short agenda?

Avery Dunn

avery.dunn@velotech.com
